simplifyAccountsPreparation.description: Simplify accounts preparation for small limited companies registered in England.
steps: Collect guided financial data including bank transactions and other inputs.
Prepare draft accounts as per HMRC requirements.
Allow user review and approval of final accounts.
Prepare final accounts ready for filing.
simplifyAccountsPreparation.companyType: Small limited companies registered in England

ensureComplianceWithEnglandHMRC.description: Ensure compliance with England HMRC accounting and filing standards.
standards: Accounts prepared according to HMRC rules for small limited companies.
Filing procedures follow HMRC electronic submission requirements.
Accounts include all mandatory disclosures and formats as per HMRC.
ensureComplianceWithEnglandHMRC.scope: Small limited companies only, no complex corporate structures.

provideClearUserFriendlyGuidance.description: Provide clear, user-friendly guidance throughout the accounts preparation and filing process.
features: Contextual help and tips relevant to farm and packhouse teams.
Review workflow with clear approval steps.
Status indicators for progress and compliance checks.

helpUsersOptimizeTaxManagement.description: Help users optimize tax management efficiently within HMRC guidelines.
suggestions: General efficiency suggestions without providing tax advice.
Highlight potential tax reliefs applicable to small limited companies.
Ensure accounts preparation supports optimal tax filing.
helpUsersOptimizeTaxManagement.limitations: No detailed tax advice or complex audit support.
